summary: Markets appear defensive and highly headline-driven, with geopolitical tensions, surging oil, a firm dollar, higher Treasury yields, and hawkish rate expectations pressuring equities and gold. Bitcoin is rebounding but broader crypto sentiment remains mixed, while Ethereum is testing support and risk appetite appears selective.
